Headline: Shree Ganesh Properties & Investment Auctioning Promoter Shares of ICFC Finance Limited And Himalayan Life Insurance From Today
Full Content:
Shree Ganesh Properties & Investment Private Limited
is auctioning the 1,00,612 unit promoter shares of
ICFC Finance Limited (ICFC)
and 1,24,833 units of promoter shares of
Himalayan Life Insurance Limited (HLI)
from today i.e. 11th Poush to 19th Poush, 2080 to the qualified interested parties, including promoter shareholders, the general public, and institutions.
1,00,612 unit promoter shares of ICFC and 1,24,833 unit promoter shares of HLI are being auctioned. The minimum bid quantity for both promoters’ shares of ICFC and HLI is 10,000 units. However, bidders are required to abide by the Nepal Insurance Authority's and Nepal Rastra Bank rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
Qualified interested promoter shareholders/general public/institutions are eligible to bid in the auction. Rs. 175 is the minimum bid rate for the ICFC auction and Rs. 200 is the minimum bid rate for the HLI auction. Interested investors should submit their bids at the central office of the bank, NIC Asia Capital Limited, located at Thapathali-11, Kathmandu, 4th floor of Trade Tower.
NIC Asia Capital Limited is the auction manager of the issue.
As of writing, ICFC has an LTP of Rs. 485.40 and HLI has an LTP of Rs. 452.

Headline: Prudential Capital Management Selling Promoter Shares of PRVU, ICFC, NLIC, NIMB, KBL And PCBL Via Auction From Today
Full Content:
Prudential Capital Management Company Limited is selling the promoter shares of these six financial institutions —
Prabhu Bank Limited (PRVU), ICFC Finance Limited (ICFC), Nepal Life Insurance Company Limited (NLIC), Nepal Investment Mega Bank (NIMB), Kumari Bank Limited (KBL), and
Prime Commercial Bank Limited (PCBL)
via auction. The auction, spanning from the 11th Poush to the 19th Poush, 2080, is offered to the qualified interested parties, including promoter shareholders, the general public, and institutions.
The auction includes 68,729 units of promoter shares from Prabhu Bank Limited, with a minimum bid rate set at Rs. 110 per unit. Interested bidders are required to adhere to a minimum bid quantity of 5,000 units. Prudential Capital Management is also selling 92,616 units of promoter shares from ICFC Finance Limited for auction, with a minimum bid rate of Rs. 175 per unit. The minimum bid quantity for ICFC promoter shares is set at 10,000 units.
In the case of Nepal Life Insurance Company Limited, the auction comprises 5,23,112 units of promoter shares, each available at a minimum bid rate of Rs. 325. Bidders are required to comply with a minimum bid quantity of 10,000 units. Prudential Capital Management is also selling 1,09,678 units of promoter shares from Nepal Investment Mega Bank Limited for auction, with a minimum bid rate of Rs. 120 per unit. The minimum bid quantity for NIMB promoter shares is set at 10,000 units.
The auction includes 5,49,626 units of promoter shares from Kumari Bank Limited, with a minimum bid rate set at Rs. 100 per unit. Interested bidders are required to adhere to a minimum bid quantity of 25,000 units. Prudential Capital Management is also selling 49,717 units of promoter shares from Prime Commercial Bank Limited for auction, with a minimum bid rate of Rs. 110 per unit. The minimum bid quantity for PCBL promoter shares is set at 5,000 units.
Bidders are reminded to adhere to the regulations stipulated by both Nepal Rastra Bank and Nepal Insurance Authority, ensuring that the specified quantity of shares per entity is not exceeded. Qualified interested promoter shareholders/general public/institutions, the general public, and institutions are eligible to bid for the auction within the 19th Poush.
NIC Asia Capital Limited is appointed as the auction manager for all six auctions.

Headline: Last day to bid 3.79 lakhs unit shares of ICFC Finance;Investors from auction also to get 10.5% bonus share
Full Content:
ICFC Finance Company Limited (ICFC) has been auctioning its promoter right shares and ordinary right share to general public from Magh 15, to Magh 25 2072 (today).

According to a notice published by the finance company, it is auctioning 3,18,871 units promoter right share and 60,903 ordinary right share after the rights shares issued on Mangsir 8, 2072 were not fully subscribed by the investors. It had offered right shares in the ratio of 2:1.

The auction winner will also get 10.5 percent bonus share proposed by the finance company which is subject to approval from upcoming AGM.

The bid will open on Friday, Magh 22, 2072.

Bidders must quote a minimum price of Rs 100 per unit, which means that the lowest bid amount must be more than Rs 100.

Global IME Capital Limited is the issue manager for this auction.

The finance has urged the interested bidders to submit their bids by 3:00 PM today at the Global IME Capital Limited located at Jamal, Kathmandu.

The investors applying for the auction can deposit the bid amount in the account number 0010000371CC of Global IME Capital Limited at Citizens Bank International Limited.

The last trading price (LTP) of ICFC Finance stood at Rs 231 & as on January 28, 2016. Also, the LTP of ICFC promoter share stood at Rs 105 as on December 16, 2015.
